description: Sandbox API, manifest format, permissions, and addon categories for StreamKit+ integration addons. Worker code runs in an isolated VM with global APIs (network, events, dashboard, api, …) — no SDK imports.
rules: Addon worker code uses global sandbox APIs only — never import StreamKit+ SDK or main-app modules inside the VM.
Never use app translation keys or LangData tuples in addon code; use plain strings or { en, ru?, uk? } objects.
Request minimal manifest permissions; avoid ROOT if possible.
Validate query.token === data.token on HTTP endpoints meant only for embedded web pages (widget/application/overlay).
Build TypeScript to index.js before install; the worker executes index.js only.
Set manifest id to ORG/REPO matching the GitHub repository path.
Keep initial index.js load synchronous work under 5 seconds; defer heavy work to setTimeout, setInterval, or async handlers.
Use @rocketman-streamkit/types for TypeScript; do not add @types/node to addon projects.
